So a lot of ebay links expired or switched to more expensive variants. My bad. I updated the listings for the ones I've bought in the regular 'bike lights' post. For the most part, these seem to be different sellers selling the same product from the same factory for different prices. They even have the same marketing images and come in the same box/shipping style.

Anyways, I also tried out a few more budget bike lights. (I get paid good money, and I figure as hobbies go, blowing $15/month to equip about 20 bicyclists with free safety equipment isn't a bad thing.)

New "Cheapest working Light" I found:

http://www.ebay.com/itm/Bicycle-Cycle-Cycling-Bike-Silicone-Warning-Tail-Flashing-Frog-Light-Red-/201321576336?hash=item2edfb37790%3Ag%3AXhcAAOSw34FVG7z~

These here run for $0.76, and that's a record. The clasp system is pretty straightforward. It works, it binds around just about any seatpost pretty well, and you can use whatever material you want as a shunt if you've got one of those very old seatposts that's super-narrow at least until you pop a tube and slice a section of that off. Point is, it's functional, fairly bright, hits an array of things, and won't be confused for a car taillight if you're riding in Positions 1 or 3 (if you took the MSF course, you know what I mean- where you're to either side of a vehicle. I've been bumped from the back before by cars who just somehow assumed in poor visibility that my rear tail light was a car's brake light malfunctioning or some such.)

Anyways, this thing when steady-on is rainbow-colored. Flashing, for me, it's just blue-ish, still not going to confuse any driver into thinking it's a tail light. Unless they're color blind. Well, there's no accounting for that special level of special...

Cheapest PAIR. Traditional 'gummy' style. It's $0.45 cents each, roughly. That's super-cheap. I just ordered a set.

http://www.ebay.com/itm/252019341379?_trksid=p11400.c100368.m3767&_trkparms=aid%3D333008%26algo%3DRIC.MBE%26ao%3D1%26asc%3D20150120121922%26meid%3D97743ec270424445b2754605a7c76832%26pid%3D100368%26rk%3D2%26rkt%3D8%26mehot%3Dpp%26sd%3D201321576336

Another <$0.80 type I tried out:

http://www.ebay.com/itm/Premium-Frog-Safety-Wheel-Light-Bike-Bicycle-Silicone-2X-LED-Superbright-1pc-New-/291548841823?hash=item43e1aa475f%3Ag%3A2lUAAOSwu4BV3WMS

These ones are also pretty decent, though their downside is that if you mount one up front it's positively blinding. That said, they're still very cheap, lightweight, and bright, which is what matters most. I gave them away to a kid to put on the back of his BMX.
